description: Pi from npm under its current scope, never run.
why: The npm value is the only witness: nothing runs pi, so ~/.pi does not exist and removing @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent from the catalog turns must_find red. openclaw is forbidden because it is built on Pi's libraries, and installing Pi must not read as it.
known_gaps: The pi.dev/install.sh route is not exercised. Its install layout has not been read, so it has no value in the catalog yet.
